At 3 stacks, '''Master Yi's''' next basic attack [[File:On-attack icon.svg|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Attacking|An icon representing the keyword On-attack]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Attacking|on-attack]] is empowered to consume the stacks [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] and strike twice, the second strike dealing 50% AD physical damage.
description.text: Innate: Master Yi's basic attacks on-hit generate a stack of Double Strike for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits and stacking up to 3 times. At 3 stacks, Master Yi's next basic attack on-attack is empowered to consume the stacks on-hit and strike twice, the second strike dealing 50% AD physical damage.

description2.raw: The second strike applies [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] effects, triggers [[File:On-attack icon.svg|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Attacking|An icon representing the keyword On-attack]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Attacking|on-attack]] effects, and is affected by [[File:Critical strike icon.png|20px|link=Critical strike|An icon representing the keyword Critical strike]] [[:Critical strike|critical strike]] modifiers.
description2.text: The second strike applies on-hit effects, triggers on-attack effects, and is affected by critical strike modifiers.

description3.raw: If '''Master Yi's''' primary target is killed before the second strike, he will automatically target another nearby enemy.

notes.text:
The second strike separately rolls a critical strike.
* PENDING FOR TEST: Does it trigger Sundered Sky's Lightshield Strike?
If the stacks expire during the empowered attack's first strike animation, the attack cancels and the normal basic attack windup starts. (bug)
Double Strike does not cause Master Yi to attack twice. Effects that trigger on completing the attack windup will only trigger once and thus do not interact with Double Strike. (e.g. Hail of Blades).
Since Double Strike resets the counter with the first strike, and the second strike applies on-hit effects, the second strike is able to add a stack for the next Double Strike activation.
If Double Strike's target becomes untargetable shortly after the triggering attack, it will still occur and deal its effects as usual.
Basic attacks that are dodged, blocked, or missed while Master Yi is blinded will not generate any stacks of Double Strike nor refresh the duration of active stacks.
Double Strike's interaction with parry effects at 3 stacks (the damage of the strikes is negated in all cases):
* If the triggering basic attack is dodged, Master Yi will not perform the second strike nor consume the stacks.
* If the triggering basic attack is blocked, Master Yi will perform the second strike but not consume the stacks.
* If the triggering basic attack misses while Master Yi is blinded, he will consume the stacks.
** The second strike will fail to hit the target at all if the triggering attack misses. On-attack effects do not occur, despite the attack animation playing.(bug)
